jobs.title: Developer Advocate - Network APIs
jobs.description:
All Together, Extraordinary

adunaglobal.com

Aduna is the Connector of networks, bringing together leading telecom operators and technology partners to simplify global access to Network APIs. Through a single, unified platform, we enable businesses and developers to build more secure, seamless and innovative digital services.

We are looking for a Developer Advocate to become Aduna's public-facing voice within the global developer community as part of our Demand Generation team.

As Adunaâs voice in the developer community, youâll bring network APIs closer to developers and turn awareness into real adoption. Youâll grow and engage developer audiences across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and independent communities including GitHub, Stack Overflow, YouTube and Discord, using technical content, events, demos and hands-on engagement to take developers from curiosity to their first successful API call.

What You'll Do

  • Grow an engaged developer audience for network APIs across your own and Aduna's channels: technical videos, livestreams, blog posts, social media and newsletters.
  • Speak at developer conferences, meetups and hackathons, with live coding and live demos on the Aduna sandbox as your signature format.
  • Build and publish sample apps, starter kits and tutorials on GitHub that developers actually use and star.
  • Run community programmes: hackathons, workshops, office hours and developer challenges, in your region and beyond.
  • Feed what developers tell you back to Product and Engineering, and work with our use-case experts to keep content technically accurate.
  • Own and report your numbers: audience growth, content reach and engagement, sandbox sign-ups, time to first API call and active developers.

What You bring:

  • A proven public developer audience. For example, a substantial following on LinkedIn, X, YouTube or GitHub, a blog or newsletter with regular readers, or an active community you run or co-lead. Please include links and numbers in your application.
  • A track record as a speaker at developer conferences or meetups, with recordings we can watch, and confidence doing live demos in front of a technical audience.
  • 4+ years in developer relations, technical evangelism or hands-on engineering with public-facing work.
  • The ability to write and ship working code (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java), not just describe it.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and REST APIs.
  • A results mindset: you set goals for reach and adoption, measure them and adjust.
  • Plus: experience with CPaaS, telecom APIs, identity, authentication or fraud prevention, and existing ties to developer communities in India or Central and Eastern Europe

Why Join Aduna?

  • Be the public voice of a company shaping the future of programmable connectivity.
  • Build a Developer Advocacy function from the ground up and have a direct impact on strategy.
  • Work at the intersection of telecommunications, cloud platforms, APIs, and developer ecosystems.
  • Collaborate with global technology leaders, hyperscalers, and innovative partners.
  • Gain visibility across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Help define how developers interact with one of the most exciting new technology categories in the market.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team of industry experts.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Professional development and conference participation opportunities.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and global-scale initiatives.
  • The chance to shape a rapidly growing company and make a visible impact from day one.
How to apply:
Please include links to your public profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn, YouTube or blog) and at least one recording of a talk or live demo. Applications without public references won't be considered. Shortlisted candidates will give a 10-minute live demo in the interview.
Â 

Aduna is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who are passionate about driving the next wave of innovation in telecommunications.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer, US East
jobs.description:
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â 
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written!

About the role

Sales Engineers are central to our go-to-market team. As the primary technical resource for our most strategic prospects and accounts in the US East region, you'll own pre-sales strategy and technical validation for complex, enterprise-grade solutions. Working closely with customers and prospects, you'll help drive expansions and cross-sells.

You'll lead the technical evaluation stage of the sales cycle and work with internal and external stakeholders as the trusted technical advisor and product advocate for Secure Code Warrior. As AI reshapes how software is created, you'll help customers understand how to secure AI-assisted development. You'll explain this clearly to both executives and engineers, and build lasting customer relationships throughout the sales cycle.

What you will do

Deliver high-impact presentations and live product demonstrations to prospects and existing customers, including demos of our latest AI-focused capabilities

Own the technical response to RFPs and security questionnaires

Lead Proof of Value (PoV) engagements and pilots end to end, from success criteria through to results write-ups, findings, and executive business review

Develop integration strategies for the Secure Code Warrior platform, based on each customer's vendor requirements and existing AppSec and developer tech stack

Gather customer requirements and develop business cases for Product Management

Partner with Marketing and Product Management to build sales and product assets that accelerate deals and customer success

Conduct AI market research and contribute to go-to-market strategy

Use automation and AI tooling to work more efficiently

What you will bring

5+ years as a Sales Engineer, ideally at a cybersecurity software company or a security services provider serving large enterprises

Deep domain knowledge of AI landscape, AppSec, developer security, and the SaaS cybersecurity market

Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and the security and governance questions it raises

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to think on your feet in live customer conversations

Confident client-facing presence, including presenting to technical practitioners and senior stakeholders

Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills for a range of audiences

Experienced in adopting AI tools in your own workflow

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.
